# NetBrain names new CEO with Blackstone backing over the line

Jan 22, 2026

Network operations (NetOps) solutions provider NetBrain Technologies appointed Bernadette Nixon as its new CEO, following an investment by Blackstone.

Nixon joins the firm from AI search startup Algolia, where she led the company through global expansion. NetBrain said her experience will be “instrumental as AI becomes increasingly central to modern network operations and automation.” [...] NetBrain founder Lingping Gao will transition from the CEO role to chair of the board, having steered the ship for more than two decades. Alongside the executive reshuffle, ex-Casa Systems CEO Jerry Guo and IRIS Software Group chairman Gus Malezis joined NetBrain’s board.

“NetBrain is redefining how enterprises run their networks using AI and automation to help prevent outages, strengthen resilience, and improve security,” Nixon noted in a statement. “[Gao’s] passion and innovation have made NetBrain a category leader in network automation, and I look forward to working with our exceptional team to build on this strong foundation.” [...] Upon closing its investment, Blackstone said it’ll help NetBrain expand its footprint to take advantage of what it claims to be a $30 billion NetOps market. In addition to its Burlington base, NetBrain has locations in Munich, Toronto, Hyderabad, and Beijing.

“[Gao] is a visionary founder who has built an exceptional business, and we are excited to continue working with him in his new role as chair,” Vishal Amin, senior managing director at Blackstone, added. “We believe Bernadette has the experience and strategic leadership skills to support the next phase of NetBrain’s growth journey and that the company is exceptionally well-positioned as AI reshapes network operations.”

News source: SDxCentral

# NetBrain Appoints Three New Executives to Help Customers Chart Their Path to Agentic NetOps

Business Wire

3 min read

Luvlynn Lee, Sean Dolan, and Scott Fitzgerald join as CCO, CRO, and CMO as enterprise network operations teams move from evaluating AI to deploying it

BURLINGTON, Mass., June 30, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--NetBrain Technologies, the pioneer of Agentic NetOps, today announced three executive appointments: Luvlynn Lee as Chief Customer Officer (CCO), Sean Dolan as Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), and Scott Fitzgerald as Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). [...] "Our customers are navigating a pivotal moment. They know AI will transform their network operations and they are looking to NetBrain to show them the path. Bringing Luvlynn, Sean, and Scott into the leadership team is a direct investment in that promise and will make us a stronger company. Luvlynn will ensure every customer has a clear and supported journey to Agentic NetOps, Sean will extend that journey to the enterprises who have not yet discovered what autonomous network operations can do for them, and Scott will make sure the market understands what is now possible."

Bernadette Nixon, Chief Executive Officer, NetBrain Technologies

Luvlynn Lee — Chief Customer Officer
